hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1; } ; echo 'Anatomy project: read docs/STATUS.md (state, user decisions, next steps) and docs/CONTRIBUTING.md first; docs/DESIGN.md before any UI change. KEEP DOCS CURRENT AS YOU GO: every commit that changes code also updates docs/STATUS.md (and DECISIONS/ARCHITECTURE/DESIGN as relevant) - a hook blocks code-only commits. Done = npm run verify + e2e:smoke + screenshots reviewed + docs updated + CI green.'
